title: Forecast-Assisted Deep Reinforcement Learning for Energy Management of Hydrogen-Enabled Community Microgrids
authors: Mohamed Atef, Sanath Alahakoon, Umme Mumtahina, et al.
abstract: Hydrogen-enabled community microgrids can improve renewable energy utilization and local resilience, but their operation is complicated by uncertain residential demand, variable renewable generation, dynamic electricity prices, and the coupled dynamics of battery and hydrogen storage.
